verdict.rationale: Klaviyo is an email/SMS marketing platform, so automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions suppression lists, unsubscribe handling, bounce or complaint processing, or CAN-SPAM/GDPR compliance defaults. The pack covers only APIs, SDKs, the MCP server, pricing, and AI features.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
